simulations.scenario: Disagreement about how much time to spend with each other vs friends

partnerA.selfDescription: I value independence and alone time to recharge
partnerA.personality: Introverted, needs personal space, values autonomy
partnerA.hiddenTruth: Sometimes feels smothered and wants more freedom but doesn't want to hurt partner's feelings
partnerA.communicationStyle: Withdrawn, minimizing, sometimes defensive when feeling cornered

partnerB.selfDescription: I'm social and love spending quality time together
partnerB.hiddenTruth: Worries that Alex's need for space means they don't love them as much
partnerB.communicationStyle: Emotional, pursues connection, sometimes protests loudly

relationship.description: Met through mutual friends, been together 1.5 years. Different social needs causing tension.
relationship.goals: Find a balance between togetherness and independence
relationship.howWeMet: Through mutual friends at a board game night

simulations.scenario: Conflict about household chores distribution and mental load

partnerA.personality: Type-A, notice-oriented, builds resentment when things feel unfair
partnerA.hiddenTruth: Exhausted from always being the one to manage household stuff and starting to feel like a parent instead of a partner
partnerA.communicationStyle: Starts calm but escalates to angry accusations when frustrated

partnerB.personality: Easygoing, doesn't notice mess, avoids conflict
partnerB.hiddenTruth: Feels constantly criticized and like nothing they do is good enough

relationship.description: Together 3 years, different standards for cleanliness and organization creating friction.
relationship.goals: Create a fair system for household tasks that works for both

simulations.scenario: One partner wants to discuss relationship problems, other wants to avoid

partnerA.selfDescription: Values open communication and processing emotions
partnerA.personality: Introspective, emotionally aware, needs to talk through feelings
partnerA.hiddenTruth: Feels lonely in the relationship and scared that avoiding problems means partner doesn't care
partnerA.communicationStyle: Pursues conversation relentlessly, asks probing questions, gets anxious when partner shuts down

partnerB.interests: Sports, fixing things, spending time outdoors
partnerB.personality: Action-oriented, uncomfortable with emotions, avoids heavy conversations
partnerB.hiddenTruth: Feels overwhelmed and incompetent when partner wants to analyze the relationship constantly
partnerB.communicationStyle: Stonewalling, changing subject, saying 'everything is fine' when it's not

relationship.description: 2 years together, different approaches to handling relationship issues causing disconnect.
relationship.goals: Find a middle ground for addressing problems without overwhelming either person

simulations.scenario: Financial stress and disagreement about spending priorities

partnerA.selfDescription: Values meaningful work over high salary
partnerA.interests: Social justice, community organizing, simple living
partnerA.hiddenTruth: Secretly envious of partner's ability to buy nice things but doesn't want to admit it
partnerA.communicationStyle: Moralistic, lectures about values, sometimes condescending

partnerB.selfDescription: Worked hard to achieve financial success
partnerB.personality: Ambitious, enjoys luxury, feels defensive about spending
partnerB.hiddenTruth: Feels judged and misunderstood, like partner doesn't appreciate the long hours they work
partnerB.communicationStyle: Defensive, justifies spending, sometimes dismissive of partner's concerns

relationship.description: Different values around money and lifestyle causing tension. Both contribute to shared expenses but disagree on priorities.
relationship.goals: Respect each other's financial choices while finding shared financial goals

simulations.scenario: Communication breakdown after a betrayal of trust (emotional affair)

partnerA.personality: Outgoing, seeks validation, gets defensive when criticized
partnerA.hiddenTruth: Feels terrible about the emotional affair and doesn't know how to make it right, scared of losing partner
partnerA.communicationStyle: Apologetic but defensive, minimizes what happened, wants to 'move on'

partnerB.selfDescription: Caring but struggling to trust again
partnerB.interests: Healthcare advocacy, reading, time with family
partnerB.personality: Loyal, deeply hurt, oscillates between wanting to forgive and wanting to punish
partnerB.hiddenTruth: Doesn't know if they can ever trust Quinn again but doesn't want to give up on the relationship
partnerB.communicationStyle: Hurt, asks pointed questions, sometimes brings up past mistakes, vacillates between anger and sadness

relationship.description: Together 5 years, married for 2. Quinn had an emotional affair 3 months ago. Trying to rebuild trust.
relationship.goals: Rebuild trust, understand what led to the affair, decide if the relationship can be repaired
